caseNameFull: Ilseng v. United States Ilseng v. United States and McKercher v. United States
attorneys: Mr. David H. Cannon for petitioners. Assistant Solicitor General Fahy and Assistant Attorney General Berge for the United States.

opinions.text:
Petition for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas and Mr. Justice Jackson took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.

Reported below: 120 F. 2d 823.
